verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the core is open source on GitHub and can be run entirely on your own infrastructure (honcho-docs-9). The CLI's `honcho start` brings up the API, deriver, Postgres and Redis via Docker (honcho-docs-10), and the MCP server can also run locally or in Docker (honcho-docs-16). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-host deployment, and production deployment guidance beyond the local Docker start.
